steps.script: Dim data as Data.DataFrame = Parameters("data").AsDataFrame Dim cols as Integer = data.VariableCount Dim L as String = "" For j as Integer = 1 To cols L &= "X" & j.ToString() & ": " & data.Variables(j - 1).Title & vbCrLf Next Dim outputParameters As New ParameterBag outputParameters.Add("variable_list", New FilledParameter(True, L)) Return outputParameters

Dim qx As String = Parameters("expression").AsString If 0 = qx.Length Then Throw New TemplateOperationCancelledException End If Dim data as Data.DataFrame = Parameters("data").AsDataFrame Dim cols as Integer = data.VariableCount For k as Integer = 0 To cols - 1 qx = qx.Replace("X" & (k + 1).ToString(), data.Variables(k).Title) Next Dim outputParameters As New ParameterBag outputParameters.Add("default_new_column_name", New FilledParameter(True, qx)) Return outputParameters

Dim data As DataFrame = Parameters("data").AsDataFrame Dim cols as Integer = data.VariableCount Dim Q as String = Parameters("expression").AsString.ToUpper() Host.Session("LastFunction") = Q Dim rows as Integer = data.MaxRows Dim t as String = Parameters("new_column_name").AsString
Dim outputFrame As New DataFrame Dim outputVariable As New DoubleVariable(rows, t) outputFrame.Variables.Add(outputVariable)
'Work through the rows Dim clc As New Calcit(Q) Dim x(cols) as Double For N as Integer = 0 To rows - 1 'Put the current Row into the work array Dim binit as Boolean = False For j as Integer = 0 To cols - 1 x(j) = data.Variables(j).AsDoubleVariable.Data(N) If x(j) = Constant.MISSING Then binit = True Exit For End If Next If binit Then 'Don't calculate missing data outputVariable.Data(N) = Constant.MISSING Else 'Calculate the new value outputVariable.Data(N) = Sheet.XSpr(clc.Evaluate(x)) End If Next Dim outputParameters As New ParameterBag outputParameters.AddOutput("output", outputFrame) Return outputParameters
